name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-cutscene-ground
title: Super Mario World - Cutscene Ground
description:
A rip of the ground tiles used in the castle destruction cutscenes (with newly created corner and side tiles). Can be used as flowery grass or sand/stone depending on the palette.

Doesn't interfere with the normal grassland ledges and slopes. The included map 16 uses vanilla palette lines 5 and 6, but it works with various palettes. Replaces FG3.

There are three versions included:
-One that replaces the "bush 3" tiles
-One that replaces the "skinny horizontal pipe" tiles
-One that replaces the "skinny vertical pipe" tiles

Credit not necessary but appreciated of course.
